title: Why the Sun and the Moon Live in the Sky

game.start: Meet Mmong's sea family with Utin! Tap the green turtle, red crab, silver fish, and blue dolphin.
game.praise: What a big, cheerful family! Every sea friend splashes happily in the lagoon!

game.start: Test the three carved wooden pillars with Utin! Tap each tall pillar in order from left to right.
game.praise: Strong and steady! All three carved wooden pillars stand proud in the golden sunshine!

game.start: Set out welcome gifts! Match plantains to the brass tray, shells to the mat, and coconuts to the bowl.
game.praise: Everything looks welcoming! The grand Calabar courtyard is ready for Mmong's big visit!

game.start: Play Utin's cheerful welcome call on the wooden drum! Tap three times when the ring glows green.
game.praise: Three warm drumbeats! Golden music sparkles right past the wiggling green reeds!

game.start: Welcome the first sea guests inside! Tap all four sparkling silver fish in the water.
game.praise: Shimmer and dart! All four silver fish sparkle happily in the cool courtyard ripples!

game.start: Keep things dry! Match the brass tray to the shelf, basket to the bench, and drum to the step.
game.praise: High and dry! Every courtyard treasure rests safely above the knee-deep turquoise waves!

game.start: Greet Mmong's sea friends at the gate! Tap the red crab, green turtle, and blue dolphin in order.
game.praise: Ready to enter! Red crab, green turtle, and blue dolphin splash happily at the open gate!

game.start: Brighten Utin and Ofiong's glowing crowns on the rooftop! Tap three times when the ring glows green.
game.praise: Three radiant bursts! Golden sunlight and silver moonlight shimmer bright upon the thatch rooftop!

game.start: Light up Utin and Ofiong's new sky home! Tap all four twilight stars in the clouds.
game.praise: Twinkle and shine! Four bright twilight stars glow across the wide velvet sky!

spreads.title: A Sparkling Mirror on the Sea

game.start: Share the sky-glow! Match the golden sunbeam to Mmong, silver moonbeam to the turtle, and starlight to the dolphin.
game.praise: Shining together! Sunbeams, moonbeams, and starlight dance joyfully across Mmong's sparkling waves!
